note: Simplified Chinese on-screen text for every recorded journey. Keys are the English text the recorder and renderer emit. A zh-Hans take records the app in 简体中文, so a Web UI name in a caption is the app's own zh-Hans text for it (gbdraw/web/js/utils/i18n-catalogs/zh-Hans.js); the English-only journeys keep their older strings. Picked file names pass through unchanged.
